policy: Research-only directory, no automatic merge into production.
Unknown optional legacy fields are omitted, never zero-filled.
Founding assertions are individually sourced profile facts, not an unattributed founded_year.
No grant, secondary sale, acquisition price, future commitment or debt facility is projected as legacy company funding.
Month/year dates are retained in notes and sidecar without padding a day.
No unresolved investor IDs or new relationship kinds are fabricated.
